title: Return the bigger with max()
prompt: Write `bigger`, which returns the larger of its two parameters using the built-in max(). `solve` returns bigger(a, b).
hints: Built-in functions return values too; you can return what max() returns.

docs.name: return value
docs.what: Ends the function and hands value back to whoever called it.

docs.name: max(a, b)
docs.what: Returns the larger of the two numbers.
